prompt: We have 460 million points with 16-byte vectors. Our calculation says 7-8GB but each instance is using 20GB. We stopped ingestion for a week, barely any queries, still 20GB average across all six instances. What is Qdrant storing that takes 20GB?

assertions.text: Asks for actual configuration (on_disk, quantization, payload settings) BEFORE providing a breakdown
Recommends checking metrics endpoint to separate data usage from cache
Mentions full-text indexes as a possible hidden RAM consumer
Does NOT invent specific GB estimates for ID tracker or payload without knowing the actual config
Suggests investigating with support/core team if config review doesn't explain the gap
